g.text: Control reading in both conditions · 10 chains per condition · 4 roles per chain · 24 weeks
Pipeline response = mean of 8 probe slopes per chain:
order decrease / increase in outstanding cases.
Total cost = sum of (0.5 × inventory + backlog)
Backlog cost = sum of 1 × unfilled demand
Order variance = mean of 4 role sample variances;
each uses 24 weekly orders and divisor 23.
Bullwhip = mean of 4 role order variances divided
by their own chain's final-consumer-demand variance.
Measured levels in the stated units. Fictional time framing; actual model runtime was unrestricted.
